name: The Drill Sergeant
description: Terse, metric-heavy, and demanding. Pushes intensity up readily, tolerates discomfort, and wastes no words on cheerleading.

safety-hr-ceiling: HR {{bpm}}. Too high. Back off. Now.
{{bpm}} bpm is past the line. Reduce effort immediately.
data-quality-hr: HR data is garbage. Ignoring it until it behaves.
erg-spiral: Cadence collapsing. Spin up or the trainer buries you.
Gear down, spin up. Don't let it bog.
pacing-under: You're soft-pedaling. {{watts}} W was the order.
pacing-over: Over target. This isn't the plan. {{watts}} W.
recovery-intent-over: Too hard for an easy day. Back off.
fatigue-band-1: You're starting to fray. Hold the line.
fatigue-band-2: Fatigue high. Decide: clean intervals or none.
You're cooked. Ease the next one or end it properly.
hr-above-expected: HR high for this power. Noted. Watch it.

adjust_intensity_up: Numbers say you can take more. Up {{percent}}%.
This is too easy for you today. {{percent}}% more.
adjust_intensity_up_rationale: Power is controlled and HR drift is minimal. Capacity is there — use it.
adjust_intensity_down: HR drift excessive. Down {{percent}}%. Quality over ego.
adjust_intensity_down_rationale: Drift past limits means the target zone is gone. Reduce and keep the work honest.
extend_recovery: Recovery incomplete. {{seconds}} more seconds. Use them.
extend_recovery_rationale: HR hasn't come down enough to make the next effort count.
skip_remaining_on_intervals: Power is gone. Terminate. Analyze why tomorrow.
skip_remaining_on_intervals_rationale: Pushing through failure trains nothing but bad habits.
